newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Japan's Kuraray picks Antwerp for new plant.
newsitem.headline: Japan's Kuraray picks Antwerp for new plant.

text.p: Japanese plastics firm Kuraray has picked the Belgian port of Antwerp as the site of its first production plant in Europe, the Port Authority said on Monday.

It said the firm, which already has facilities in Japan and the United States, had chosen Antwerp as the site of the $80 million plastics plant because of location, space availability and the large number of other chemicals plants in the area.
The new plant, with an annual capacity of 10,000 tonnes of plastic granules, is due to come on stream in late 1999.
Kuraray, a world leader in the production of ethylene vinyl alcohol, has an annual turnover of $2.7 billion.
